mechanism: Dexamethasone may increase moxifloxacin metabolism via CYP3A4 induction, potentially reducing fluoroquinolone efficacy; additionally, both agents can prolong QT interval with additive cardiac risk.
action: Monitor QT interval and cardiac function; ensure adequate moxifloxacin dosing for infection control; consider alternative fluoroquinolone or steroid if QT prolongation is present or concerning.
